methodology.input: First human-written target sentence of each selected English WebNLG training entry.
methodology.gold_usage: RDF input triples are withheld from prompts and used only for post-extraction endpoint scoring.
methodology.learning: Claims are stored in Cheetah; model weights are unchanged.
methodology.transcript_format: Recorded JSON prompts with repeated inline response_schema omitted; schema_file identifies the checked-in schema. Model responses are parsed from recorded response text.
methodology.endpoint_metric: Directed subject/object pairs after case, whitespace, underscore and enclosing-quote normalization; predicates are not scored. This is not RDF triple F1.
methodology.limits: Source overlap is not an entailment proof. These are small diagnostic samples without a closed-book baseline or held-out generalization measurement.

coverage_run.initial_database_state: Reused the manual proof database; one proposed claim was already stored.

fresh_database_acceptance.timing_scope: Complete test: server startup, two teaching calls, known question, untaught control, Cheetah shutdown/restart and repeated known question. Not per-answer latency.

teaching.source_text: Aarhus Airport is located in Tirstrup.

prompt_without_inline_schema.task: Extract directed subject/relation/object claims from SOURCE only. Copy subject and object from one exact quote. Extract ALL subjects, not only the first. Relations are snake_case verbs or roles written in that quote (e.g. located_in, born_in, language, leader). Save explicit noun-based facts too. No background knowledge. No negated or speculative claims. Empty facts only if unsupported. stop_reason=completed; needs_more_context=false; missing_snippets=[].
